FOLDEE Titanium Frameset
A lighter, corrosion-proof evolution of the FOLDEE design. Manufactured in Taiwan using precision titanium tubing for riders who want maximum durability with minimum weight.
The Titanium Frameset takes the proven FOLDEE design and pushes it further.
Titanium offers an exceptional combination of strength, low weight and corrosion resistance, making it an ideal material for a bike designed to go everywhere. Compared to steel, the titanium frame significantly reduces overall weight while maintaining the stiffness and strength needed for cargo use.
These frames are manufactured in Taiwan using modern production techniques and carefully controlled welding processes. This allows consistent quality while keeping the design accessible to more riders.
The result is a frame that retains the practicality of the original FOLDEE concept while adding the long-term durability and weight savings titanium is known for.
For riders who want the ultimate travelling cargo bike, titanium delivers.
Technical highlights
• Precision manufactured from premium titanium tubing • Significantly lighter than the steel frame (~14 kg vs ~18 kg complete bike) • Excellent corrosion resistance — ideal for long-term ownership • High strength-to-weight ratio suited to cargo loads
Finish
Sandblasted titanium with hand-brushed decals.
* Complete bikes are to give an idea visually of how the bike could look. This product is a frame not a complete bike.
